Leblanc.watch: If you’re hit by another ability while LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice’s mark is active, you take more damage, so back away until the mark disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Naafiri E Eviscerate to get out of chain range before the root takes effect. If LeBlanc creates a clone after losing health, don’t cast your abilities immediately; check which one is attacking.
Leblanc.fight: Engage after LeBlanc W Distortion is down and the time she could use it to return has passed. Fill your pack before trading, and if an area attack like LeBlanc W Distortion damages it, recall and restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate. Avoid trading while LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice’s mark is active.
Leblanc.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, then apply a bleed to LeBlanc with the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then land the second Q hit and a basic attack while the bleed lasts. Don’t rush this combo while LeBlanc can return with LeBlanc W Distortion.
Leblanc.escape: Engage after LeBlanc W Distortion has been used, once the window to return has passed or she has already used her return. The moment LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is down is another chance to close in. If the chain hits you, use Naafiri E Eviscerate to create distance before the root; do not engage relying on Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit as an escape unless you are certain of securing a takedown.
Leblanc.build: Build magic resistance to defend against LeBlanc’s damage. Prioritize a spell shield that can stop her combo starting with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice.
Leblanc.laning: Don’t force your way toward ranged LeBlanc. Clear the incoming wave with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, and keep up in levels. Look for an opening to engage when LeBlanc W Distortion or LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is down. If LeBlanc disappears from mid, alert your team immediately; after pushing the lane, build a lead through roams.
Leblanc.phase: In the early lane, farming is difficult against ranged LeBlanc, but Naafiri can clear waves with her pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. In late-game front-to-back teamfights, area damage can wipe out your pack, so build on your mid-game lead.
Leblanc.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; target one enemy backliner from the flank or behind. Before you go in, check your pack’s numbers and whether area attacks like LeBlanc W Distortion are down. If your pack has been hurt, restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate. Engage with Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit when you can reliably pick off the first target, then use the second cast after a takedown to reach your next target or escape.

Hwei.build: The available information doesn’t specify a first purchase. Against Hwei, prioritize movement speed so you can leave his telegraphed attack areas, and build magic resistance for defense. Armor doesn’t help against his damage, and be careful about choices that add a lot of health alone, since Hwei Q Subject: Disaster scales with maximum health.
Hwei.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, then apply a bleed to Hwei with the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Follow with Naafiri E Eviscerate to close in, then land the second Q hit and a basic attack. Hit Hwei with the second dagger while he’s bleeding to aim for its bonus damage based on missing health.
Hwei.escape: Your opening to engage comes just after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used. Hwei has no mobility ability, so close the gap then with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, Naafiri E Eviscerate, or Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit. Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit can only be cast again after you get a takedown, so use it when you can pick off the first target.
Hwei.fight: Close the gap just after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or waveclear. Check your pack’s numbers before engaging; if Hwei’s area damage has hurt it, recall and restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate. In trades, apply a bleed with the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, then find an angle to land the second hit while the bleed lasts.
Hwei.laning: Don’t risk walking up for last hits against ranged Hwei. Clear the wave with Naafiri P We Are More’s packmates and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, and keep up in levels. Engage only when Hwei’s skillshots are down, and move immediately if you’re hit so you can avoid his follow-up abilities. After pushing the lane, use the movement speed from Naafiri W The Call of the Pack to move to a side lane or the enemy jungle.
Hwei.phase: In the early lane, farming is difficult against ranged Hwei, but you can hold on and poke with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. In late-game front-to-back teamfights, Hwei’s area damage can wipe out your pack and reduce your damage, so look for a flank.
Hwei.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. Check your pack’s numbers and whether Hwei E Subject: Torment has been used, then flank from the side or behind. If Hwei’s area damage has hurt your pack, restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then use Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit to target a backline champion when Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. If you get a takedown, use the shield from the second cast of Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit to reach your next target or escape.
Hwei.watch: If you’re caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment’s root or forced movement, you’re likely to get hit by follow-up attacks, so don’t engage hastily while this ability is available. If Hwei hits you with his first ability, move immediately to avoid his second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster can deal damage based on maximum or missing health, so be especially careful when health has decreased.

Ambessa.phase: The matchup gets easier if you avoid giving up kills early and keep up in levels. Ambessa is strong in mid game as she builds core items, but that’s also a good time for Naafiri to gain an advantage through roams and flanking. In late-game front-to-front teamfights, area damage can wipe out Naafiri’s Hounds, so build your lead before then.
Ambessa.build: Fit Executioner's Calling between core items to counter Ambessa’s healing. If you need defense, build armor instead of choosing an option that only adds magic resistance or health.
Ambessa.combo: When Ambessa W Repudiation is down and your Hounds are ready, attack in this order: Naafiri W The Call of the Pack → Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers first hit → Naafiri E Eviscerate → Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers second hit → basic attacks. Hit with the second Q while the first Q’s bleed lasts to seek bonus damage based on missing health. Don’t spend Naafiri E Eviscerate first, since Ambessa may retreat.
Ambessa.escape: The moment after Ambessa’s abilities and empowered basic attacks are down is your window to engage. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, respond immediately with Naafiri E Eviscerate, and use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack’s untargetable window to avoid the crowd control from Ambessa R Public Execution.
Ambessa.fight: Trade right after Ambessa has used her abilities and empowered basic attacks. While Ambessa W Repudiation is winding up, back off without attacking; after its effect ends, close in while sending the Hounds with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers.
Ambessa.laning: Clear waves with the Hounds and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, then use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack’s movement speed to roam after pushing the lane.
Ambessa.teamfight: Avoid engaging from the front, and recall the Hounds with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or Naafiri E Eviscerate before area attacks such as Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam. From the flank, engage with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when you can definitely take down a backliner, then use the second cast gained from participating in a kill to reach the next target or escape. Ambessa R Public Execution can target your team’s backline, so position yourself outside the line between Ambessa and your allied backline.
Ambessa.watch: When you see Ambessa W Repudiation’s shield and windup, stop attacking and move out of range. If you dodge the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, the second hit won’t be prepared; if it’s hard to dodge, move close to Ambessa instead of staying near the blade’s edge. If Ambessa E Lacerate slows you, use Naafiri E Eviscerate immediately to dodge the Q that follows.

Akshan.teamfight: Instead of engaging from the front, check your Hound count from the flank or behind and target one enemy backliner, including Akshan. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when you can secure the first takedown, then use the second cast after participating in a kill to reach the next target or escape. If Akshan marks you as the Scoundrel, fight outside his finishing range so he can’t take you down alone.
Akshan.build: Build armor first to withstand the main damage from Akshan Q Avengerang, E Heroic Swing, and R Comeuppance. Naafiri’s physical damage works well against Akshan’s relatively low armor, so also make sure you have enough Hounds when dealing damage.
Akshan.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging and check your Hound count. Apply a bleed with the first Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and send in the Hounds, then follow Akshan and close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate before hitting with the second Q and basic attacks. If area damage has reduced the Hounds’ health, also time E to call them back and restore their health.
Akshan.escape: Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, E Eviscerate, and R Hounds' Pursuit. In particular, fight where there are no walls: Akshan can’t use E to engage or disengage there, so push him toward open ground.
Akshan.fight: Bait out Akshan E Heroic Swing, then close the gap and fight. Apply a bleed with the first Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and send in the Hounds, then hit with the second dagger while the bleed lasts. Don’t use Naafiri E Eviscerate too early before engaging, so you can follow Akshan if he retreats.
Akshan.laning: Early on, last hit with the Hounds and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers while keeping up in levels. Akshan Q Avengerang travels farther when it hits minions, so don’t rely on standing behind the wave to dodge it. When Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, close the gap; when you can push the lane, move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle.
Akshan.phase: In late-game frontal teamfights, area damage can wipe out the Hounds, so build on the lead you gained in mid game.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits a minion, so avoid its out-and-back path even from behind the wave. Akshan E Heroic Swing uses walls to create distance, but ends if a champion collides with its path. When low on health, if Akshan R Comeuppance’s targeting indicator appears, get behind terrain to block the bullets.

Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting a minion, so don’t stand in line with allied minions. Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb can lock you down and leave you open to damage, so be cautious about engaging while both are available. If Lissandra casts Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, she can avoid damage, so don’t dump all your finishing damage at once.
Lissandra.build: Lissandra’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. If Lissandra is sustaining through Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items. Naafiri’s physical damage is effective against Lissandra’s low armor.
Lissandra.escape: Your window to close the gap is after Lissandra E Glacial Path has been used. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down too, close in with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Eviscerate, or engage with Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit when you can secure the kill. R can only be cast again after a takedown, so make sure that’s likely before engaging.
Lissandra.fight: Trade just after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses. Apply a bleed with the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and send in the pack, then find an angle to land the second Q hit while the bleed lasts. When Lissandra is about to use an area ability, protect your damage by recalling the pack with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or Naafiri E Eviscerate.
Lissandra.laning: Don’t force your way toward ranged Lissandra. Secure last hits with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, and keep up in levels. Position at an angle to allied minions so you avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard. If you can push the lane, move to a side lane or the enemy jungle to create a numbers advantage.
Lissandra.phase: In the early game, preserve your last hits and levels against ranged Lissandra, and trade when Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down. In late-game front-to-back teamfights, area damage can wipe out your pack and reduce Naafiri’s damage.
Lissandra.teamfight: Instead of engaging from the front, check from the flank or behind whether Lissandra E Glacial Path and her crowd-control abilities are down. Check your pack’s numbers before engaging, and restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate if area damage has hurt it. Engage on a target you can pick off with Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit, get a takedown, then use the second R to reach your next target or escape.
Lissandra.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, then apply a bleed and send in the pack with the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then land the second Q hit on the bleeding Lissandra and follow up with a basic attack. If the self-stasis from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is still active, stagger your damage to match when the stasis ends.

Ahri.laning: Don’t overextend for last hits against ranged Ahri; keep minions between you and her to dodge Ahri E Charm. Clear pushed waves with the Hounds and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers while keeping up in levels. After pushing the lane, use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack’s movement speed to move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle.
Ahri.build: Get an answer to Ahri E Charm first, then build magic resistance against Ahri’s magic damage. If Ahri P Essence Theft’s healing makes her hard to finish, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Ahri.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, and apply a bleed to Ahri with the first Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then hit with the second Q while the bleed lasts and finish with basic attacks. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is available, watch for her escape so you don’t spend E too early.
Ahri.escape: Once Ahri E Charm is also down, you can close the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, E Eviscerate, and R Hounds' Pursuit. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when a takedown is certain, so you can use the second cast to escape or continue onto the next target.
Ahri.fight: Engage right after Ahri E Charm is down. Apply a bleed with the first Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and send in the Hounds, then find an angle for the second hit while the bleed lasts. If area damage such as Ahri Q Orb of Deception has reduced the Hounds’ health, call them back with Naafiri E Eviscerate to restore it.
Ahri.phase: In the early laning phase, melee Naafiri is at a disadvantage farming against ranged Ahri. In late-game frontal teamfights, area damage can wipe out the Hounds and reduce your damage, so build on your mid-game lead.
Ahri.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; wait on the flank or behind for Ahri E Charm to be used. Check your Hound count, and if area damage has reduced their health, restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate before targeting Ahri. When participating in a takedown lets you recast Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit, move to the next target or escape.
Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you can take her full follow-up combo, so dodge it by standing behind minions. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on its return, so keep moving outside its return path even after dodging the first pass.

Akali.build: Get magic resistance first against Akali’s main damage. Also build health so you can withstand the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution. Movement speed also helps you get out of Akali’s attack range.
Akali.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, and apply a bleed to Akali with the first Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Then close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, hit the bleeding Akali with the second Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, and use basic attacks. If Akali E Shuriken Flip is available, dodge its first hit before starting this sequence.
Akali.escape: Don’t engage just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down. Dodge Akali E Shuriken Flip and engage before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up. Don’t use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit unless the first takedown is certain.
Akali.fight: Apply a bleed with the first Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, then find an angle for the second hit while the bleed lasts. If Akali’s area attacks have reduced the Hounds’ health, call them back with Naafiri E Eviscerate to restore it.
Akali.laning: Last hit and clear waves with the Hounds and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers while keeping up in levels. Dodge the first hit of Akali E Shuriken Flip, and look for trades when Akali emerges from Akali W Twilight Shroud. After pushing the lane, use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack’s movement speed to create a numbers advantage in a side lane or the enemy jungle.
Akali.phase: In late-game front-to-front teamfights, area damage can wipe out the Hounds and reduce your damage, so look for opportunities from the flank.
Akali.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; from the flank, check your Hound count and whether Akali is about to use area damage. Before the area attack lands, recall the Hounds with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or Naafiri E Eviscerate; if their health is reduced, restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit on a backliner you can take down, then, after participating in a kill, use the second cast to target someone else or escape.
Akali.watch: Dodging the first hit of Akali E Shuriken Flip is the most important thing. If you’re marked, the second dash follows you to wherever you retreat, so save Naafiri E Eviscerate to respond if you get hit. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, and its second hit deals more damage based on missing health.

Anivia.build: Anivia’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Anivia P Rebirth is letting her survive, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Anivia.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, then apply a bleed to Anivia with the first Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and send in the Hounds. Then close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, hit with the second Q while the bleed lasts, and use basic attacks. If Anivia’s area damage has reduced the Hounds’ health, also time E to call them back and restore their health.
Anivia.escape: Anivia has no mobility spell, so the window to engage comes after Anivia Q Flash Frost and W Crystallize are down. Use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack for movement speed and close the gap with E Eviscerate or R Hounds' Pursuit. R requires participation in a takedown to be used again, so use it when you can definitely take down the first target.
Anivia.fight: Approach with a full pack of Hounds right when Anivia Q Flash Frost has been used. Anivia has no mobility spell and relatively low armor, so closing the gap lets you deal Naafiri’s physical damage effectively. However, if Anivia P Rebirth is still available, go in with an ally rather than trying to break the egg alone.
Anivia.laning: Don’t force your way toward ranged Anivia; clear pushed waves with Naafiri P We Are More and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers while keeping up in levels. When you can push the lane, use your movement speed to move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle.
Anivia.phase: Anivia’s terrain control and area damage become difficult to handle in late game, so build on the lead you gained in mid game.
Anivia.teamfight: Avoid narrow paths where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape, and approach from the flank in open areas. Watch for the moment to recall the Hounds with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or E Eviscerate so area damage such as Anivia Q Flash Frost doesn’t wipe them out. Engage with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when you can take down the first target, then use the second cast gained from participating in a kill to reach the next target or escape.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost can detonate mid-flight and stun you, so dodge beyond the blast radius instead of just sidestepping the projectile. If you’re hit by Q or inside an enlarged Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage; when chilled, use Naafiri E Eviscerate to escape the storm and avoid the next attack. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.

Annie.build: Annie deals magic damage, so build magic resistance first to withstand her burst combo. Account for Annie R Summon: Tibbers’ penetration; don’t rely only on resistance, and also get movement speed to dodge area damage.
Annie.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, then attack in this order: Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers first hit → Naafiri E Eviscerate → Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers second hit → basic attacks. Start the bleed and the Hounds’ attacks with the first Q, then hit with the second Q while the bleed lasts. If area damage such as Annie W Incinerate is about to land, also use Naafiri E Eviscerate to restore the Hounds’ health.
Annie.escape: The moment after Annie P Pyromania’s stun has been used is your chance to engage. Annie has no mobility spell, so close the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate during that window. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit only when you can secure the first takedown and reset it by participating in the kill.
Annie.fight: When Annie P Pyromania’s stun is down, apply a bleed with the first Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and hit with the second while the bleed lasts. If Annie W Incinerate has damaged the Hounds, call them back with Naafiri E Eviscerate to restore their health, then focus your damage.
Annie.laning: Early on, don’t force your way toward ranged Annie; last hit and clear the lane with the Hounds and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers.
Annie.phase: In the early lane, melee Naafiri is at a disadvantage farming against ranged Annie, but you can keep up in levels with the Hounds and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. In late-game front-to-front teamfights, Annie’s area damage can easily wipe out the Hounds, so avoid engaging from the front.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie’s stun is ready or Annie is missing, don’t stand clumped with your allies. From the flank, check your Hound count and whether Annie has used her area damage, then engage with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit on a target you can definitely take down. After participating in a kill, use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit again to reach the next target or escape, and keep your distance from summoned Tibbers.
Annie.watch: When white light swirls around Annie, Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, so stay outside her ability range. Annie W Incinerate and Annie R Summon: Tibbers deal area damage that can wipe out the Hounds, so recall them with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or Naafiri E Eviscerate. If Tibbers is summoned, don’t stay in the area even after taking down Annie.

AurelionSol.build: Build magic resistance first against Aurelion Sol’s main damage. Since Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health, consider resistance and movement speed instead of stacking health alone.
AurelionSol.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging and apply a bleed with the first Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then hit with the second Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers while the bleed lasts and follow with basic attacks. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when you can definitely take down the first target.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment after you bait out Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is your window to engage. Also confirm that Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend are down before closing the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, E Eviscerate, and R Hounds' Pursuit. Don’t engage with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit if the takedown is uncertain.
AurelionSol.fight: Engage and fight right after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down. Before engaging, build up the summons from Naafiri P We Are More, then target the enemy with the first Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to send in the Hounds. If area damage from Aurelion Sol reduces their health, call them back with Naafiri E Eviscerate to restore it.
AurelionSol.laning: Early on, last hit at range with the Hounds and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers while keeping up in levels. Don’t let Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light hit you and grant him Stardust; pressure hard when Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down. After pushing the lane, move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle to build an early lead.
AurelionSol.phase: Early on, Naafiri is well suited to pressure Aurelion Sol, who has low armor and limited mobility. Build on your lead in mid game with roams and flanks. In late game, Aurelion Sol grows stronger with permanently accumulated Stardust, and area damage can wipe out Naafiri’s Hounds, so avoid front-to-front teamfights.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; look for an angle to take down Aurelion Sol with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit from the flank or behind. If you participate in a kill, use the second Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit to reach the next target or escape.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health and stacks Stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its aim. When low on health, also avoid the edge of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, which can execute you, and move outside immediately if caught. Spread out so multiple people aren’t hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Aurora.build: If Aurora is surviving through healing, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Aurora’s damage. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about choices that only add a lot of health.
Aurora.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging and apply a bleed to Aurora with the first Q Darkin Daggers to send in the Hounds. If Aurora retreats with E The Weirding, follow with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then hit with the second Q Darkin Daggers and basic attacks while the bleed lasts. Also account for using E Eviscerate to call back the Hounds and restore their health if Aurora’s area damage reduces it.
Aurora.escape: Don’t go deep just because Aurora E The Weirding is down. The window to close the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, E Eviscerate, and R Hounds' Pursuit comes after Aurora W Across the Veil is also down and before R Between Worlds comes back. Also look for an approach when Aurora Q Twofold Hex is down, but retreat first if you’re low on health while cursed.
Aurora.fight: Naafiri’s physical damage works well against Aurora’s low armor. After making Aurora retreat with Aurora E The Weirding, close the gap again with Naafiri E Eviscerate or R Hounds' Pursuit. When Aurora disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, don’t rush into a targeted engage; wait for her to reappear.
Aurora.laning: Instead of forcing your way toward ranged Aurora, collect pushed waves and distant last hits with Naafiri P We Are More and Q Darkin Daggers. Engage only when Aurora’s skillshots are down, and build up your Hounds before a fight. If you can push the lane, move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle to create a numbers advantage.
Aurora.phase: Early on, Naafiri can clear and poke with the Hounds, but you need to farm and keep up in levels against ranged Aurora. In late-game front-to-front teamfights, area abilities thin your Hounds and reduce your damage output, so build on your mid-game lead.
Aurora.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; from the flank, check your Hound count and whether Aurora E The Weirding and R Between Worlds have been used. After participating in a kill, use the second R Hounds' Pursuit to target the next enemy or escape.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, move out of the line between you and Aurora to avoid the return damage. The lower your health, the more damage the return deals, so don’t stay while cursed. When Aurora R Between Worlds appears, you’re slowed when leaving it, and Aurora can move to the opposite side of the zone, so don’t chase directly.

Azir.build: Get movement speed first so you can leave the range of Azir's telegraphed attacks. If you need resistance, build magic resistance against Azir's magic damage. Naafiri's physical damage is effective against Azir's low armor.
Azir.combo: Before engaging, activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack and apply a bleed to Azir with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to send in the pack. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then hit the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers while the bleed lasts and finish with basic attacks. Don't use Naafiri E Eviscerate too hastily to start the engage, since Azir may retreat.
Azir.escape: Right after you make Azir use Azir E Shifting Sands is your chance to close the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, Naafiri E Eviscerate, or Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit. If Azir places a soldier beyond a wall, he can use Azir E Shifting Sands toward it, so block that route or engage before he can. While Azir R Emperor's Divide is available, account for the risk of being knocked back and look for an opening after it is down.
Azir.fight: Close in on Azir when his soldiers have stopped in one place or Azir E Shifting Sands is down. In a long fight, the soldiers will keep damaging you, so attack in short bursts with your pack replenished. If Azir W Arise! area damage thins the pack, restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate to maintain your damage.
Azir.laning: Don't force your way toward Azir while he farms from range. Clear the pushed-in wave with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, and keep up in levels. If you can push the lane, create an advantage by roaming.
Azir.phase: Early on, hold the lane with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, and pressure Azir when Azir R Emperor's Divide is unavailable. Later, Azir becomes stronger and Naafiri's pack can easily be wiped out by area damage, so don't fight head-on for long.
Azir.teamfight: If you and your team dive in together from the front or through a narrow passage, Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock back the engaging players. Approach from the flank or behind in an open area. When a takedown lets you recast Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit, continue to the next target or use it to escape.
Azir.watch: Step out of the straight line where Azir W Arise! soldiers are standing. After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves his soldiers, circle around to their side or behind them. Azir R Emperor's Divide knocks Naafiri back and leaves a wall, so don't engage through narrow passages. If it looks like the pack will be wiped out by area damage, recall it early with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or Naafiri E Eviscerate.

Cassiopeia.build: If Cassiopeia is sustaining through Cassiopeia E Twin Fang healing, slot Executioner's Calling between core items. Cassiopeia's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance instead of armor.
Cassiopeia.combo: Before engaging, activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack and apply a bleed to Cassiopeia with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers as you send the pack. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then hit the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and use basic attacks while the bleed lasts. Before starting with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit, make sure you can secure the first target.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility skill, so engage right after Cassiopeia W Miasma is placed elsewhere. If Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze is down, or you avoided its stun by turning away during the cast, close the gap with Naafiri E Eviscerate or Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit. If you're standing in Miasma, don't try to escape with a mobility skill; walk out using movement speed.
Cassiopeia.fight: Cassiopeia has no mobility skill and low armor, so pressure her briefly and close the gap when Cassiopeia W Miasma hasn't been placed. Apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, then find an angle to hit the second cast while the bleed lasts. If you've been hit by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, don't keep fighting; engage again after the poison ends.
Cassiopeia.laning: If ranged poke makes it hard to approach, secure last hits and the pushed-in wave with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in when the opponent's skillshots are down, and if you push the lane, create a numbers advantage by roaming.
Cassiopeia.phase: Later, Cassiopeia's sustained damage is threatening and Naafiri's pack can be wiped out by area abilities, so build on your earlier advantage.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Don't engage head-on. Cut off Cassiopeia's route from the flank or look for an opening right after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere. Check your pack count before engaging; if area damage has thinned it, recall and restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when you can secure the target, then recast it after a takedown to continue to the next target or escape.
Cassiopeia.watch: You can't use mobility skills such as Naafiri E Eviscerate and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so close in before she lays it down or go around without stepping into it. If hit by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, get out of range until the poison ends to avoid the empowered damage and healing from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. When you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn away to avoid being stunned.

Corki.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Corki E Gatling Gun and Corki R Missile Barrage. Resistance doesn't work against the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions, so build health too. Attack speed reduction also helps lower Corki's basic attack damage.
Corki.combo: Before engaging, activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack and apply a bleed to Corki with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then use the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and basic attacks while the bleed lasts. Start after Corki W Valkyrie is down, and don't spend Naafiri E Eviscerate first so you can follow if Corki retreats.
Corki.escape: Engage right after Corki W Valkyrie is down. While his mobility is unavailable, send the pack with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and close the gap with Naafiri E Eviscerate or Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when you can secure a takedown.
Corki.fight: Right after Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie is a chance to close in. If Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb or Corki R Missile Barrage thins your pack, recall it with Naafiri E Eviscerate to restore it before fighting. Move out of the frontal area of Corki E Gatling Gun and hit the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers on Corki while he is bleeding.
Corki.laning: Don't force your way toward ranged Corki. Secure last hits and clear the pushed-in wave with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Pressure him when his skillshots are down; if you make him use Corki W Valkyrie, close in right afterward. Disrupt his farming from the early game, push the lane, then gain an advantage by roaming.
Corki.phase: Corki's base stats are low during the first five levels, so pressure his farming. Corki gets stronger as he builds items, and in late-game front-to-front teamfights Naafiri's pack can be wiped out by area abilities, so snowball your advantage before then.
Corki.teamfight: If your pack has been thinned, restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then target Corki with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit. If you get a takedown, use the shield from the second cast of Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit to continue to the next target or escape.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages targets around the first one it hits, so don't hide behind minions; get out of range. Reposition in particular to avoid being hit by the third missile in quick succession. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance when it hits, so don't stay in front of him; move off to the side.

Diana.build: Build magic resistance first against Diana's damage. Get movement speed too, so you can walk out of the range of her telegraphed attacks.
Diana.combo: Before engaging, activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack and apply a bleed to Diana with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Then close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate and use the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and basic attacks. Start after Diana W Pale Cascade's shield is down, and don't use Naafiri E Eviscerate too early and lose your means to chase.
Diana.escape: The window to engage is right after Diana E Lunar Rush is down without a mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike. Close the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, Naafiri E Eviscerate, or Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits you, create distance because Diana E Lunar Rush may reset.
Diana.fight: Fight after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear. Apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, then hit the second cast while the bleed lasts. If Diana's area damage thins your pack, recall and restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate.
Diana.phase: Snowball your advantage through roams and flank attacks in the mid game. In the late game, your pack can easily be wiped out by area abilities, so avoid front-to-front fights.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out from your allies and watch for flank routes so multiple players aren't pulled in by Diana R Moonfall. Use the second cast of Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit after a takedown to reach the next target or escape.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies and leaves a mark. Dodge it to the side; if it hits you, move away because Diana E Lunar Rush may reset. If you anticipate Diana R Moonfall, look for an angle to evade it with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack.

Ekko.build: If Ekko R Chronobreak's healing is stopping your assassination, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Against Ekko's damage, build magic resistance rather than armor. If you're having trouble with the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence when you have no mobility available, consider tenacity first.
Ekko.combo: Before engaging, activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack and apply a bleed to Ekko with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then use the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and basic attacks on Ekko while he is bleeding. Don't spend Naafiri E Eviscerate first to start the engage, since Ekko may retreat.
Ekko.escape: When you see the tell for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, avoid its range and use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack to dodge its stun. Even if Ekko E Phase Dive is down, don't engage recklessly while Ekko R Chronobreak is still available. In particular, the window before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back is a chance to close the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, Naafiri E Eviscerate, and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit.
Ekko.fight: Apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and send your pack onto Ekko, then hit the second cast while the bleed lasts. Avoid the range of Ekko W Parallel Convergence and close in when Ekko E Phase Dive or Ekko R Chronobreak is down. If area damage has thinned your pack, recall and restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then keep dealing damage.
Ekko.laning: Clear minions with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, and keep up in levels. Use the moment Ekko Q Timewinder is down as a chance to approach, and avoid its return path. If you push the lane, use the movement speed from Naafiri W The Call of the Pack to move to a side lane or the enemy jungle.
Ekko.phase: The mid game is when Naafiri's roams and flank attacks are strong, so turn opportunities when Ekko R Chronobreak is down into an advantage. In late-game front-to-front teamfights, Naafiri's pack can be wiped out by area abilities, reducing your damage output.
Ekko.teamfight: Approach from the flank or behind rather than from the front, and check your pack count and whether Ekko W Parallel Convergence has been used before engaging. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when you can secure Ekko. If a takedown grants a second cast of Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit, continue to the next target or escape.
Ekko.watch: When you see the tell for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area. Dodge the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder, and if you see the afterimage of Ekko R Chronobreak, don't chase recklessly even if health is low.

Fizz.build: The starting item can't be determined from the available information alone. The damage from Fizz W Seastone Trident, Fizz E Playful / Trickster, and Fizz R Chum the Waters is all magic, so build magic resistance rather than armor.
Fizz.combo: When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack and apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Then close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, hit the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers while the bleed lasts, and follow with basic attacks. Also account for recalling your pack with Naafiri E Eviscerate to restore its health if area damage thins it.
Fizz.escape: The window to engage is when Fizz E Playful / Trickster enters cooldown. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, he can also use it to escape, so check whether it has been used as well. While Fizz R Chum the Waters is a threat, look for a timing to dodge it with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack.
Fizz.fight: Treat the moment right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down as a chance to counterattack. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, he can use it to escape, so check his mobility before closing the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate. Naafiri's physical damage is effective against Fizz's relatively low armor.
Fizz.laning: Before a fight, replenish the summons from Naafiri P We Are More, and send your pack first with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers just before closing in on Fizz. Try to trade when Fizz misses a last hit with an empowered basic attack from Fizz W Seastone Trident or uses Fizz E Playful / Trickster. After pushing the lane, use the movement speed from Naafiri W The Call of the Pack to roam.
Fizz.phase: Early on, look for an opening when Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, and clear the lane with Naafiri's pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. In late-game front-to-front teamfights, your pack can be wiped out by area abilities, reducing your damage output, so build on your mid-game advantage.
Fizz.teamfight: Work with your allies to make Fizz use Fizz E Playful / Trickster first, then focus him once it's down. Approach from the flank instead of engaging head-on, check your pack count, and use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit on a target you can secure. If you get a takedown, use the recast of Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit to reach the next target or escape.
Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster can deal damage while he engages or escapes, so don't chase recklessly before he uses it. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark detonates. When Fizz uses Fizz R Chum the Waters, use the brief untargetability from Naafiri W The Call of the Pack.

Galio.build: Naafiri's main physical damage is effective against Galio's low armor, so pressure him with physical damage early. Against Galio's damage, prioritize magic resistance over armor. Galio Q Winds of War deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Galio.combo: With your pack alive and after dodging Galio W Shield of Durand and Galio E Justice Punch, activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack first. Apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and send the pack, then close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate and use the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and basic attacks. Also account for the timing to recall and restore your pack with Naafiri E Eviscerate if area damage thins it.
Galio.escape: Don't engage just because Galio E Justice Punch is down; also check Galio W Shield of Durand's taunt and whether Galio R Hero's Entrance can intervene. The window before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back is especially good for engaging; close the gap then with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when you can secure the first target and get a second cast through a takedown.
Galio.fight: Back off while Galio W Shield of Durand is charging, and start trading after its taunt is down. If you dodge the windup for Galio E Justice Punch, send your pack first with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and close the gap with Naafiri E Eviscerate. Find an angle to hit the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers while the first cast's bleed lasts.
Galio.laning: Secure last hits and the wave with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, and make Galio use his skills to clear the wave. Once Galio has spent mana, push the lane to limit his ability to affect other lanes with Galio R Hero's Entrance. After pushing, use Naafiri's movement speed to move to a side lane or the enemy jungle.
Galio.phase: Early on, Naafiri's physical damage is effective against Galio's low armor, so pressure him while clearing the wave. After learning Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit, you'll have more kill opportunities; snowball your advantage through roams and flank attacks in the mid game. In late-game front-to-front teamfights, Galio's area abilities can wipe out your pack and reduce Naafiri's damage output, so look for a flank engage.
Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero's Entrance is ready, don't start small skirmishes against Galio's team in other lanes either. Build up your pack, then use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit from the flank to take out one backliner. Use the second cast earned through a takedown to chase the next target or escape.
Galio.watch: When Galio W Shield of Durand is charging, it reduces incoming damage and extends the taunt, so don't commit damage; move out of range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch by watching for its backward windup, and avoid the tornado area where the windblasts from Galio Q Winds of War converge. When you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, immediately leave the area.

Irelia.build: If Irelia is sustaining through trades with Irelia Q Bladesurge, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items. The available information doesn’t specify a first purchase or which resistance to build.
Irelia.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging. Apply a bleed with the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, land the second Q hit on the bleeding target, then use a basic attack.
Irelia.escape: Your opening to engage comes just after you make Irelia use Irelia Q Bladesurge. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is down, you have less reason to worry about its stun, so close the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Eviscerate. Use Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit to engage when you can secure the kill.
Irelia.fight: Close the gap just after Irelia Q Bladesurge is used. Apply a bleed with the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, then find an angle to land the second hit while the bleed lasts. Against area abilities like Irelia W Defiant Dance, recall the pack with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or Eviscerate; if the pack is hurt, restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia, and back away when you’re in range for her to reach you with Irelia Q Bladesurge. After pushing the wave, move to a side lane or the enemy jungle to create a numbers advantage.
Irelia.phase: In late-game front-to-back teamfights, area damage can wipe out your pack, so build on the lead you gained earlier.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and E Flawless Duet have a major impact in teamfights, so prioritize her. Don’t engage from the front; check your pack’s numbers and whether the enemy has used their area abilities from the flank, then engage with Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit when you can secure the kill. If you get a takedown, use the second cast of Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit to reach your next target or escape.
Irelia.watch: Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge to chain through low-health minions and close the gap, so keep your distance when minions are about to die. You can avoid Irelia E Flawless Duet's stun with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Karma.build: Build magic resistance first against Karma's main damage. If healing from Karma R Mantra-empowered W is preventing a kill, slot Executioner's Calling between core items.
Karma.combo: Before engaging, activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack and apply a bleed to Karma with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers as you send the pack. Then close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, and use the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and basic attacks while the bleed lasts. If Karma Q Inner Flame thins your pack, also consider using Naafiri E Eviscerate to recall the pack and restore its health.
Karma.escape: When Karma W Focused Resolve is available, create distance first to make her use it, then engage. If tethered, create distance to break it before you're rooted, then look for another opening after the movement speed and shield from Karma E Inspire expire. Since Karma has no separate mobility skill, close the gap in this window with Naafiri E Eviscerate or Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit.
Karma.fight: Start trading after Karma Q Inner Flame is down and you have enough of your pack. Apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and send the pack, then hit the second cast while the bleed lasts. If Karma R Mantra-empowered E's shield is active, engage after it expires.
Karma.laning: Don't force an approach while taking ranged poke; reduce Karma's chances to land skills by staying behind minions or outside her range. Clear the pushed-in wave with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to keep up in levels. If you get a chance to push the lane, use your high movement speed to create a numbers advantage in a side lane or the enemy jungle.
Karma.phase: In the early lane, ranged Karma's poke puts Naafiri at a disadvantage when farming. In late-game front-to-front teamfights, area damage can easily catch your pack and reduce your damage, so build on your mid-game advantage.
Karma.teamfight: Don't start from the front; wait for Karma W Focused Resolve and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E to be down. Check your pack count from the flank, then engage with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when you can reliably take out one backliner. If you get a takedown, use the second cast of Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit to reach the next target or escape.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame's area slow can thin your pack, so recall it with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or Naafiri E Eviscerate before it hits. If you're hit by the ground effect from Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, leave the circle before it detonates again. Karma W Focused Resolve roots after a delay, so create distance while tethered to break it.

Kassadin.build: Build magic resistance first to defend against Kassadin’s damage. Armor doesn’t help against his magic damage, and Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana, not health, so Grievous Wounds doesn’t need to be a priority.
Kassadin.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, then apply a bleed with the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, land the second Q hit on the bleeding Kassadin, then follow up with basic attacks. Use Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit to engage when you can reliably finish Kassadin.
Kassadin.escape: Your opening to engage comes while Kassadin R Riftwalk is down. If the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse is down too, use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack to speed up and close in; save Naafiri E Eviscerate to follow Kassadin if he retreats. If Kassadin has used Kassadin R Riftwalk repeatedly, check his mana and counterattack when he runs out.
Kassadin.fight: Apply a bleed with the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and send in the pack, then land the second hit while the bleed lasts. If Kassadin can retreat, save Naafiri E Eviscerate to follow him.
Kassadin.laning: Fill your pack before trading, and target Kassadin first with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers so the pack doesn’t arrive late after attacking minions. Avoid unnecessary ability casts so you don’t make Kassadin E Force Pulse available again too often.
Kassadin.phase: In mid game, push the lane and build on your lead with quick roams and flanking attacks. In late game, Kassadin can use Kassadin R Riftwalk to enter the backline and escape, and Naafiri’s pack is vulnerable to area damage in front-to-back teamfights, so build your lead before the game goes long.
Kassadin.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front. Check your pack’s numbers and whether the enemy has used their area abilities from the flank or behind. If your pack has been hit by area damage, restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then engage with Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit on a backline target you can pick off. If you get a takedown, use the second cast of Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit to reach your next target or escape, and don’t stand alone within Kassadin R Riftwalk range.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin E Force Pulse slows you, and its cooldown is reduced the more abilities you use near Kassadin. Avoid unnecessary ability casts, and look for a chance to engage after Kassadin R Riftwalk is down. Kassadin Q Null Sphere grants a shield that absorbs magic damage, but Naafiri deals mostly physical damage.

Lux.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave the area telegraphed by Lux E Lucent Singularity. Armor won’t help against Lux’s magic damage, so build magic resistance if you need defense.
Lux.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging. If Lux Q Light Binding misses, apply a bleed with the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Follow with Naafiri E Eviscerate to close in, land the second Q hit, then use a basic attack. If Lux’s area damage has hurt your pack, account for the option to recall it with E and restore its health.
Lux.escape: Your opening to engage comes just after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no mobility ability to create distance again, so approach from the flank and close in with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Eviscerate. Use Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit when you can reliably pick off the first target, so you can follow up with the second cast after a takedown.
Lux.fight: Start a fight when you bait Lux Q Light Binding and make it miss. Fill your pack before engaging, then hit Lux with the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to send in the pack and apply a bleed. Land the second hit while the bleed lasts to deal bonus damage based on missing health.
Lux.laning: Don’t force your way toward ranged Lux. Clear the incoming wave with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, and keep up in levels. Lux Q Light Binding roots the first two enemies it hits, so don’t stand in a line with your ally. When you can push the lane, don’t stay in mid; use your high movement speed to create a numbers advantage in a side lane or the enemy jungle.
Lux.phase: In the early game, farming is difficult because Lux is ranged, but you can clear waves with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. In late-game front-to-back teamfights, Lux’s area damage can wipe out your pack and reduce your damage, so look for a flank.
Lux.teamfight: If you group up and engage from the front, Lux E Lucent Singularity can block your path, so approach from the flank or behind, splitting your direction from your allies. Use Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit when you have an angle to reliably pick off Lux, then use the second cast after a takedown to reach your next target or escape.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, it’s hard to dodge her follow-up abilities, so bait the Q and approach after it misses. Leave the area marked by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and sidestep when the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark appears. If Lux hits you with an ability, create distance so she can’t detonate Lux P Illumination’s mark with a basic attack.

Malzahar.build: Build magic resistance first against Malzahar’s main damage from Q Call of the Void, W Void Swarm, and E Malefic Visions. If Malzahar R Nether Grasp’s suppression is a problem, you can remove it with Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. R damage scales with maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Malzahar.combo: Break Malzahar P Void Shift first with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. When all-inning, activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack, then apply a bleed and send in the pack with the first hit of Q before following with E Eviscerate. Land the second Q hit while the bleed lasts, then finish with basic attacks.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no ability to create distance on his own, so your opening to engage comes when Malzahar Q Call of the Void is down and W Void Swarm has disappeared. Don’t engage first with Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit unless you’re sure you can get a takedown.
Malzahar.fight: Break Malzahar P Void Shift with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, then find an angle to land the second Q hit while the bleed lasts. If Malzahar W Void Swarm is already active, clear the Voidlings with area abilities, and engage when Malzahar Q Call of the Void is down. If area damage has hurt your pack, recall and restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate to preserve your damage in the fight.
Malzahar.laning: Don’t go for last hits next to minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions; back away until those minions are cleared. Clear the incoming wave with Naafiri’s pack and Q Darkin Daggers, and keep up in levels. If Malzahar pushes the lane, pressure him with your jungler, and break Malzahar P Void Shift before going in.
Malzahar.phase: In the early game, clear the lane with Naafiri’s pack and Q Darkin Daggers to reduce Malzahar’s opportunities to build up. Malzahar grows stronger over time, while Naafiri’s pack is vulnerable to area damage in late-game front-to-back teamfights, so build an advantage before the game goes long.
Malzahar.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; check Malzahar P Void Shift and W Void Swarm from the flank or behind. If Voidlings are active, clear them first with area abilities; if your pack has been hurt, restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate. Engage with Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit when you have a clear target to pick off, then use the second R after a takedown to follow up on another target or escape.
Malzahar.watch: When Malzahar P Void Shift is active, he takes reduced damage, so break it first with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers before engaging. Malzahar Q Call of the Void silences you; if you see it being cast, delay your engage and move outside the two portals. After Malzahar R Nether Grasp catches you, Naafiri’s mobility abilities and shields can’t remove the suppression, so don’t pass through areas without vision alone while Malzahar can use R.

Mel.build: Mel’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. Also consider movement speed to get out of the area of Mel Q Radiant Volley and Mel E Solar Snare.
Mel.combo: Bait out Mel W Rebuttal with a basic attack, then activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack after its effect ends. Apply a bleed and send in the pack with the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, close the gap with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then land the second Q hit and a basic attack while the bleed lasts. Use Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit to engage when you can reliably pick off the first target.
Mel.escape: Your opening to engage comes just after Mel E Solar Snare is down and Mel W Rebuttal has been used. If Mel E Solar Snare is still available, sidestep the center and save Naafiri E Eviscerate to dodge its root or follow up. Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit can only be cast again after a takedown, so don’t engage if the kill is uncertain.
Mel.fight: Fill your pack, then close in to fight when Mel E Solar Snare or Mel W Rebuttal is down. If an area ability like Mel Q Radiant Volley has hurt your pack, recall and restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate. Mel has no mobility ability and low armor, so focus your pack and physical damage when you get on her.
Mel.laning: Don’t take unnecessary ranged poke to approach. Clear the incoming wave with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, and keep up in levels. Look for an angle to engage when Mel E Solar Snare is down, and push the lane early to limit Mel’s chance to build stacks on Mel R Golden Eclipse. After pushing the lane, use the movement speed from Naafiri W The Call of the Pack to move to a side lane or the enemy jungle.
Mel.phase: In the early game, pressure Mel to delay her item timing, and look for kill opportunities after you get Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit. In mid game, build on your lead with Naafiri’s roams and flanking attacks. In late game, Mel gets stronger with her stacks and Naafiri’s pack can be wiped out by area damage, so avoid front-to-back teamfights.
Mel.teamfight: Check your pack’s numbers and whether Mel has used her area abilities, then approach from the flank or behind. Against area abilities like Mel Q Radiant Volley, recall your pack with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or Naafiri E Eviscerate; if it has been hurt, restore it with E. Engage with Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit when you can reliably pick off Mel, get a takedown, then use the second R to reach your next target or escape.
Mel.watch: Mel W Rebuttal can send Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers back at you, so bait out Mel W Rebuttal with a basic attack before using Q. If you’re hit in the center of Mel E Solar Snare, you’ll be rooted and Mel Q Radiant Volley can follow, so sidestep it and save Naafiri E Eviscerate.

Neeko.build: Build magic resist first against Neeko’s main damage. If you die after being caught by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then hit by Neeko R Pop Blossom, prioritize tenacity. Move speed also helps you leave announced danger zones.
Neeko.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, and inflict a bleed on Neeko with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then hit the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers while the bleed remains and follow with basic attacks. Don’t rush the second cast; find an angle to land it.
Neeko.escape: At this point, use Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and E Eviscerate to close the gap. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit only when you’re sure you can get a takedown, so you can use the second cast to escape or move on to another target.
Neeko.fight: Force a trade right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used. Naafiri’s physical damage works well against Neeko’s low armor, but you need a full pack before the fight to deal strong damage. If Neeko’s area damage thins your pack, use Naafiri E Eviscerate to call them back and heal them.
Neeko.laning: Don’t force your way toward ranged Neeko. Use your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to last-hit a pushed-in wave. When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used, move in to trade; after pushing the lane, use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack’s move speed to roam.
Neeko.phase: In late-game front-to-back teamfights, your pack is vulnerable to area damage, so build on your mid-game lead.
Neeko.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on. Check Neeko’s position and whether she has used her area damage from the side or behind. Neeko may approach while disguised, so spread out first if an opponent whose identity is in doubt gets close, and leave the area when you see Neeko R Pop Blossom’s windup. When your pack is intact and you have a clear target to take out, use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit to reach the backline.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up if it hits something first, so don’t stand on top of an ally. Neeko R Pop Blossom’s windup may be hidden while she’s disguised, so spread out before an opponent whose identity is in doubt gets close. Against area damage like Neeko Q Blooming Burst, use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or E Eviscerate to pull your pack back.

Orianna.build: The available information doesn’t specify a particular first purchase to prioritize. Build magic resist against Orianna’s damage, and prioritize move speed so you can leave the area where the ball is placed.
Orianna.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, and inflict a bleed on Orianna with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then hit the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers while the bleed remains and follow with basic attacks. If you use Naafiri E Eviscerate too early, it will be harder to follow Orianna when she retreats.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no mobility ability to create distance on her own, so engage after Orianna Q Command: Attack has been used and the ball is away from her. Avoid the area around the ball threatened by Orianna R Command: Shockwave. When that crowd control comes in, you can dodge it with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack, which briefly makes you untargetable.
Orianna.fight: Your chance to trade comes right after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her. Orianna E Command: Protect’s persistent defensive stats are absent then, so apply a bleed with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and find an angle for the second cast. Avoid trades where you take repeated empowered basic attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.laning: Clear the pushed-in wave with Naafiri P We Are More and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, and engage when Orianna Q Command: Attack has been used. After pushing the lane, use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack’s move speed to move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle.
Orianna.phase: Early on, you have a chance to pressure Orianna’s low base defensive stats, but Naafiri has a hard time farming against ranged opponents. In late-game front-to-back teamfights, area damage can wipe out your pack and reduce your damage, so build on your mid-game lead.
Orianna.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on. Check the ball’s position and whether Orianna has used her area damage, then approach from the side. If area damage has thinned your pack, use Naafiri E Eviscerate to call them back and heal them. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when you’re sure you can take Orianna out. Use the second cast of Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit from a takedown to reach another target or escape.
Orianna.watch: Orianna Q Command: Attack can leave the ball near an area where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in, so watch the ball when positioning. The slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and the shield from Orianna E Command: Protect can also hinder your engage, so don’t fight for long near the ball.

Qiyana.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Qiyana P Royal Privilege, Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, and E Audacity. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about stacking health alone. Don’t prioritize magic resist just for the magic damage from W Terrashape.
Qiyana.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, then use the first cast of Q Darkin Daggers to apply a bleed and send your pack in. Follow with E Eviscerate, then hit the second cast of Q Darkin Daggers while the bleed remains and follow with basic attacks. If Qiyana still has a mobility ability available, don’t use E Eviscerate early; save it to follow her if she retreats.
Qiyana.escape: If only Qiyana W Terrashape has been used, she can still escape with E Audacity, so don’t dive in right away. After she has used both W Terrashape and E Audacity, and you have dodged the crowd control from Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, close the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and E Eviscerate before Qiyana E Audacity comes back. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit as an engage only on a target you’re sure you can get a takedown on.
Qiyana.fight: Your chance to trade back comes right after Qiyana uses both W Terrashape and E Audacity; especially, engage before E Audacity comes back. Fill your pack before engaging and hit Qiyana with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to send your pack in. If Qiyana’s area damage thins your pack, use Naafiri E Eviscerate to call them back and heal them.
Qiyana.laning: Avoid walls, the river, and narrow passages; stand in open space and check which element Qiyana has. Clear the wave with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, and trade when Qiyana has used her abilities and remains in front of you. After pushing the lane, use Naafiri’s move speed to move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle and create a numbers advantage.
Qiyana.phase: Both champions are strong in the mid game, so deny Qiyana river fights and build an advantage through Naafiri’s roams and flanking attacks. Qiyana is relatively weaker late, but your pack can still be wiped out by area damage in front-to-back teamfights, so look for flank engages.
Qiyana.teamfight: Position away from walls and the river, and don’t give Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent an angle to knock several people into terrain. Instead of engaging head-on, Naafiri should check the pack count and whether area damage has been used from the side, then use R Hounds' Pursuit to take out one backliner. If a takedown grants a second cast of R Hounds' Pursuit, use it to reach another target or escape.
Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can root or grant stealth depending on the element. If she approaches with the river element, move out of range; if she disappears with the brush element, move into allied vision. Fighting with a wall behind you can let Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent knock you into it and stun you, so fight in open space. When crowd control is coming, look for an angle to dodge with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack.

Ryze.build: Ryze’s main damage is magic, so build magic resist first. Consider move speed so you can leave areas where his attacks are telegraphed.
Ryze.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, and inflict a bleed on Ryze with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Follow with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then hit the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers while the bleed remains and use basic attacks. If Ryze’s area damage has hurt your pack, consider when to use Naafiri E Eviscerate to revive them.
Ryze.escape: If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows you instead of rooting you, giving you a chance to engage. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit only when you’re sure you can take out the first target.
Ryze.fight: Close the gap after dodging Ryze E Spell Flux or when Ryze W Rune Prison is down. Naafiri’s physical damage works well against Ryze’s low armor, so fill your pack and commit your damage in a short engage. Account for using Naafiri E Eviscerate to revive your pack if Ryze’s area damage thins them.
Ryze.laning: Don’t force your way toward ranged Ryze. Use Naafiri P We Are More and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to last-hit and clear the wave. Pressure him in lane while his mana and damage are low early to slow his growth. After pushing the lane, use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack’s move speed to move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle.
Ryze.phase: Early on, Ryze’s mana and damage are low, giving Naafiri a chance to pressure him in lane. In late-game front-to-back teamfights, area damage can wipe out your pack and reduce your damage, so build your lead before the game goes long.
Ryze.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on. Check your pack count and whether Ryze has used his area damage from the side or behind. After dodging the mark from Ryze E Spell Flux, use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit to reach Ryze and deny him time to use his combo. A takedown lets you use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit again to reach another target or escape.
Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, keep your distance from allies until the mark disappears. While marked, Ryze W Rune Prison roots you and Ryze Q Overload deals increased damage, so prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux. Use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or Naafiri E Eviscerate to pull your pack back before Ryze’s area damage wipes them out.

Sylas.build: If Sylas W Kingslayer’s healing makes it hard to secure a kill, fit Executioner's Calling in while building your core items. Build magic resist rather than armor against the damage from Sylas P Petricite Burst, Q Chain Lash, and W Kingslayer.
Sylas.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, and use the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to inflict a bleed on Sylas and send your pack in. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then use the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and a basic attack while the bleed remains. If Sylas can retreat, don’t use Naafiri E Eviscerate too early.
Sylas.escape: Sylas W Kingslayer and E Abscond / Abduct both provide mobility, so be cautious about chasing when only one is down. In particular, before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back, you have an opportunity to close the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, E Eviscerate, and R Hounds' Pursuit. After the first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, dodge the second chain with Naafiri E Eviscerate.
Sylas.fight: Look for a window before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back, but don’t commit everything immediately if Sylas W Kingslayer is still available. Apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and send your pack in, then hit the second cast while the bleed remains. If Sylas’s area damage has hurt your pack, use Naafiri E Eviscerate to call them back and heal them.
Sylas.laning: Clear the wave with Naafiri P We Are More and Q Darkin Daggers, and approach when Sylas’s abilities have been used. After pushing the lane, use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack’s move speed to create a numbers advantage in a side lane or the enemy jungle.
Sylas.phase: In late-game front-to-back teamfights, area damage can wipe out Naafiri’s pack, so look for a flank engage.
Sylas.teamfight: Don’t engage first from the front. Check your pack count and whether Sylas has used his area damage, then pick a target from the side. If Sylas engages with E Abscond / Abduct, use Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to send your pack in and focus your attacks on him before he heals with Sylas W Kingslayer. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when you expect to get a takedown on the first target, then use the second cast to reach another target or escape.
Sylas.watch: Sylas E Abscond / Abduct’s second chain is more dangerous than its first dash. If the chain hits, it knocks you up and lets him attack repeatedly, so save Naafiri E Eviscerate to dodge the chain. Sylas Q Chain Lash detonates late at the crossing point, so move out immediately even if the first hit only grazes you.

Syndra.build: Buy boots early so you can dodge Syndra’s skillshots on foot.
Syndra.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, and inflict a bleed on Syndra with the first cast of Q Darkin Daggers. Follow with E Eviscerate to close in, then use the second cast of Q and basic attacks. If you use E first, you’ll have less ability to follow Syndra when she retreats.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak has a long cooldown and is her only self-peel, so right after she uses it is an opportunity to engage. Move out of the line of spheres, then close the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, E Eviscerate, and R Hounds' Pursuit. Use R when you’re sure you can take out the first target and get a second cast from the takedown.
Syndra.fight: Close the gap right after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used. Apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and send your pack in, then find an angle to hit the second cast while the bleed remains. If Syndra’s area damage thins your pack, use Naafiri E Eviscerate to call them back and heal them.
Syndra.laning: Don’t force your way toward ranged Syndra. Use Naafiri’s pack and Q Darkin Daggers to last-hit and clear the pushed-in wave. Engage only when Syndra’s skillshots have been used. After pushing the lane, use your high move speed to create a numbers advantage in a side lane or the enemy jungle.
Syndra.phase: Early on, farming against ranged Syndra is difficult, so keep up in levels with your pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. In late-game front-to-back teamfights, area damage can wipe out your pack and reduce your damage, so look for opportunities from the side.
Syndra.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on. Check whether Syndra has used Syndra E Scatter the Weak, the nearby spheres, and your pack count. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit from the side or behind to take out one backliner, then use the second R from a takedown on another target or to escape. If area damage has thinned your pack, restore them with Naafiri E Eviscerate before focusing your damage.
Syndra.watch: Syndra W Force of Will slows and deals true damage, and Syndra R Unleashed Power is dangerous at low health, so be careful engaging near a cluster of spheres and in execute range.

Talon.build: Talon deals physical damage, so build armor first with Cloth Armor early. Once Talon has lethality, it becomes difficult to withstand his damage with only a little armor, so build health as well. If Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy’s healing makes a kill difficult, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Talon.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, and inflict a bleed on Talon with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then use the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and a basic attack while the bleed remains. If Talon W Rake has damaged your pack, time Naafiri E Eviscerate so you can restore them.
Talon.escape: Right after you make Talon use Q Noxian Diplomacy, you have a chance to close in with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or E Eviscerate. After dodging the returning daggers from Talon W Rake and confirming Talon R Shadow Assault is also down, it’s a good time to counterattack. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit to engage only when you’re sure you can take out the first target.
Talon.fight: After dodging the returning daggers from Talon W Rake, close the gap right after Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy. Apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, then find an angle to hit the second cast while the bleed remains. If Talon W Rake has thinned your pack, use Naafiri E Eviscerate to call them back and heal them so you can maintain your damage.
Talon.laning: Clear the wave with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and your pack, but approach only when Talon W Rake is down. Talon can roam over terrain, so share his location and ward jungle paths.
Talon.phase: Talon’s influence declines late, but area damage can still wipe out Naafiri’s pack in front-to-back teamfights, so choose your engage carefully.
Talon.teamfight: If Talon dives the backline, group with your allies to respond, then look for a chance to counterattack after he uses Talon R Shadow Assault. Naafiri shouldn’t engage first from the front. Check your pack count and whether area damage has been used, then target one backliner with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit from the side. If you get a takedown, use the recast of Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit to reach another target or escape.
