Talon.watch: If you’re hit by Talon W Rake on its way out, move out of the returning daggers’ path. Getting hit twice stacks Talon P Blade's End and increases its damage. Don’t chase recklessly while Talon R Shadow Assault is available, since he can escape with stealth.

TwistedFate.build: Build magic resist first against the damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, W Pick a Card, and E Stacked Deck. Magic resist is more effective than armor, and move speed helps you leave announced attack zones.
TwistedFate.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging and hit with the first cast of Q Darkin Daggers. Follow with E Eviscerate to close in, then hit the second cast of Q on the bleeding target and finish with basic attacks. Start after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit only when you’re sure you can take out the first target.
TwistedFate.escape: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card has also been used, close the gap with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and E Eviscerate. If the gold card is still available, wait outside basic attack range or use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack’s untargetable duration.
TwistedFate.fight: Engage right after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used. Fill your pack before engaging, then use the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to designate your target and send your pack in. Hit the second cast while the bleed remains. If area damage has thinned your pack, use Naafiri E Eviscerate to call them back and heal them.
TwistedFate.laning: Don’t force your way toward ranged Twisted Fate. Use Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and your pack to last-hit and clear the pushed-in wave. Watch Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card and look to trade after he uses it. Once you’ve pushed the lane, move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle, and alert your allies immediately when you see Twisted Fate R Destiny’s roaming signal.
TwistedFate.phase: Early on, Naafiri can clear and poke with her pack and Q Darkin Daggers, but it’s difficult to approach ranged Twisted Fate to farm. In late-game front-to-back teamfights, area damage can wipe out your pack, so look for a flank engage.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on. Wait from the side or behind for Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card to be used. Check your pack count and the area damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. If your pack has been thinned, restore them with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then engage with R Hounds' Pursuit. A takedown grants a second R to reach another target or escape.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has a gold card ready, one basic attack will stun you, so wait outside his basic attack range. Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards is area damage, so use Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or E Eviscerate to pull your pack back before it gets hit.

Veigar.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave the telegraphed area of Veigar W Dark Matter. Veigar Q Baleful Strike, W Dark Matter, and R Primordial Burst all deal magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance if you build resistance.
Veigar.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, then hit Veigar with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to apply a bleed and send the pack to attack. Follow with Naafiri E Eviscerate to close the distance, then land the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and basic attacks while the bleed lasts. If Veigar E Event Horizon is still available, first bait it out, then engage in this order.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no skill to create distance on his own, so engage when Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Close the distance with Naafiri’s mobility and dash, but use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit only when you can reliably pick off the first target. You need a takedown to use the second cast of Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit to escape or continue onto another target.
Veigar.fight: Fight when Veigar E Event Horizon is down and Naafiri has enough packmates. If Veigar Q Baleful Strike and W Dark Matter might clear the pack, recall it with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or E Eviscerate. During trades, keep moving instead of standing still to basic attack, and dodge Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.laning: Pressure Veigar early, before he stacks up, but don’t force your way in while taking ranged poke. Veigar Q Baleful Strike passes through only the first two units it hits, so dodge it behind minions, and use Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to secure distant last hits. After pushing the lane, use your high movement speed to create a numbers advantage in a side lane or the enemy jungle.
Veigar.phase: Early on, Veigar has few stacks and low armor, giving Naafiri a strong opportunity to pressure him. Later, Veigar’s permanent stacks build up and Naafiri’s pack becomes vulnerable to area damage, so build on your early and midgame lead.
Veigar.teamfight: Before engaging head-on, check Veigar’s position, whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon, and the number of Naafiri’s pack. Engage with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit from the flank or behind when you can pick off the first target.
Veigar.watch: You’ll be stunned if you cross the edge of Veigar E Event Horizon, so if you’re trapped inside, move around within it instead of rushing toward the edge. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where and when it will land, so watch the ground indicator and sidestep. If your health is below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Vex.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can walk out of Vex’s telegraphed area attacks. Build magic resistance against Vex’s magic damage, and consider tenacity to counter her fear.
Vex.combo: If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is down, activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack first, then apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then land the second Q cast while the bleed lasts and follow up with basic attacks.
Vex.escape: Even then, if Vex P Doom 'n Gloom can still apply fear, wait, then close the distance with Naafiri’s dash ability after Doom has been consumed.
Vex.fight: Look for an opening when Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has been used and Vex W Personal Space is down. Check the pack’s numbers before engaging, and if Vex’s area damage has worn it down, recall and heal it with Naafiri E Eviscerate before fighting.
Vex.laning: Early on, don’t force your way toward ranged Vex. Use Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and the pack to secure last hits and manage the wave. Trade after Vex uses P Doom 'n Gloom on the wave, and after pushing the lane, roam with your high movement speed to gain an advantage.
Vex.phase: In the midgame, make use of Naafiri’s roaming and flanking. In the late game, avoid front-to-back teamfights where area damage can clear the pack.
Vex.teamfight: Check the pack’s numbers and the status of Vex P Doom 'n Gloom from the flank instead of engaging head-on, then target one of the backline champions. Engage with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when you can reliably pick off the first target, then use the second cast after a takedown to pursue another target or escape. Before the fight, move low-health allies out of range so they aren’t the first kill target of Vex R Shadow Surge.
Vex.watch: When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is ready, her basic abilities can interrupt dashes and fear you, so delay your engage. If you gain the Gloom mark after dashing with Naafiri E Eviscerate or R Hounds' Pursuit, move out of Vex’s basic attack range. If you are hit by Vex R Shadow Surge, move toward your allies.

Viktor.build: If you build resistance, prioritize magic resistance to mitigate Viktor’s damage.
Viktor.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, and apply a bleed to Viktor with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then land the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and basic attacks while the bleed lasts. If Viktor’s area damage has worn down the pack, also time Naafiri E Eviscerate to recall and heal it.
Viktor.escape: Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so engage after Viktor E Hextech Ray or Viktor W Gravity Field is down. If W Gravity Field is still active, don’t keep trading inside its area; leave immediately.
Viktor.fight: Close the distance the moment Viktor E Hextech Ray or Viktor W Gravity Field is used up. Account for the shield from Viktor Q Siphon Power when calculating damage. Apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, then land the second cast while the bleed lasts.
Viktor.laning: Don’t force your way toward ranged Viktor. Use Naafiri P We Are More and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to secure last hits and manage the wave. Trade when Viktor E Hextech Ray is down, and after pushing the lane, use your high movement speed to move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle.
Viktor.phase: Early on, Viktor P Glorious Evolution has few stacks, making it a good time to pressure him. Later, Viktor’s scaling builds up and Naafiri’s pack can be cleared by area damage, making direct teamfights unfavorable.
Viktor.teamfight: Check the pack’s numbers and whether Viktor has used his area damage from the flank or behind instead of approaching head-on. Avoid Viktor W Gravity Field, and engage with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit when you can reliably pick off Viktor. If you get a takedown, use the second cast of Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit to pursue another target or escape.
Viktor.watch: To dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray, don’t stand in line with the wave; move off to the side. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave its area immediately. In fights where Viktor R Arcane Storm is active, watch for the right moment to recall the pack with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or Naafiri E Eviscerate.

Vladimir.build: Prioritize magic resistance to counter Vladimir’s main damage. If healing lets him survive trades, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Vladimir.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, then apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate and land the second Q cast and basic attacks. If Vladimir has room to retreat, don’t use E first.
Vladimir.escape: Vladimir has no skill to create distance on his own, so the window to engage is after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends. Close the distance with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate when Vladimir E Tides of Blood is down or he is slowed while charging it.
Vladimir.fight: Bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first, then land a decisive attack as it ends. Apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, then line up the second cast and land it while the bleed lasts. Vladimir is also slowed while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, creating an opportunity to close the distance.
Vladimir.laning: If ranged poke is difficult to deal with, use Naafiri P We Are More and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to clear the wave pushing into you and keep up in levels. After pushing the lane, use your high movement speed to create a numbers advantage in a side lane or the enemy jungle.
Vladimir.phase: Vladimir becomes harder to deal with as the game goes on, and Naafiri’s pack is vulnerable to area damage in late-game front-to-back teamfights, so build on your midgame lead.
Vladimir.teamfight: Check the pack’s numbers and whether Vladimir has used Vladimir E Tides of Blood from the flank instead of engaging head-on. If area damage has worn down the pack, revive it with Naafiri E Eviscerate, and engage with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit only on a target you can reliably pick off. Spread out so multiple players aren’t hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague, and if you are infected, fight after the effect ends.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion can heal him and become empowered, so don’t trade while taking an empowered Q. When you see Vladimir E Tides of Blood charging, put minions between you or move out of range. If you are affected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, you take increased damage, so re-engage after the effect ends.

Xerath.build: First, have a way to cleanse or remove the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb. If you build resistance, prioritize magic resistance against Xerath’s ability damage, and build movement speed to leave telegraphed attack areas.
Xerath.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, then apply a bleed to Xerath with the first cast of Q Darkin Daggers. Follow with E Eviscerate to close in, then land the second cast of Q Darkin Daggers and follow up with basic attacks while the bleed lasts. If Xerath’s area attacks have worn down the pack, also time E Eviscerate to recall and heal it.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are down is a safe opportunity to close in. When Xerath charges Q Arcanopulse, sidestep while closing the distance to the slowed Xerath. Don’t use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit to engage if you aren’t sure you can get the kill.
Xerath.fight: Close the distance and trade right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are down. Build up the pack before engaging, then apply a bleed to Xerath with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and land the second cast while the bleed lasts. Engage with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit only when you can reliably pick off Xerath.
Xerath.laning: Early on, don’t force your way in because of Xerath’s long range. Secure last hits with Naafiri’s pack and Q Darkin Daggers while keeping up in levels. Farm while avoiding heavy damage, then push the lane and call your jungler when Xerath has spent a lot of mana. After pushing the lane, use the movement speed from Naafiri W The Call of the Pack to move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle.
Xerath.phase: Early on, Xerath’s range makes farming difficult for Naafiri, but you can survive by clearing the wave with the pack and Q Darkin Daggers. In late-game front-to-back teamfights, area attacks can clear the pack, so build on your midgame lead.
Xerath.teamfight: If the pack has been worn down, revive it with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then engage with R Hounds' Pursuit when you can reliably pick off Xerath. If you get a takedown, use the available recast of R Hounds' Pursuit to close in on another target or escape.
Xerath.watch: If you are stunned by Xerath E Shocking Orb, you can take his full follow-up combo, so don’t force your way in before this ability is down. Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging it, change direction and sidestep. If you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge immediately or engage while Xerath is unable to move.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and R Last Breath. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, and attack speed reduction also delays how soon the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest comes back.
Yasuo.escape: Engage right after Yasuo throws his tornado, while he briefly has no way to knock you up. Don't go in just because Yasuo has used E Sweeping Blade once; close the distance with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, E Eviscerate, and R Hounds' Pursuit during the window before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back. When you need to absorb Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or R Last Breath, use the brief untargetability from Naafiri W The Call of the Pack.
Yasuo.fight: Strip Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield with light poke before committing to a damage trade. The moment after Yasuo throws his tornado and his Q Steel Tempest stacks reset is your chance to engage. Check that Naafiri P We Are More has enough packmates, and if area damage has thinned the pack, revive them with Naafiri E Eviscerate.
Yasuo.laning: Manage the wave so a thin wave pushes toward your side, reducing the number of minions Yasuo can use as stepping stones to reach you with E Sweeping Blade. Don't approach recklessly before Yasuo's non-targeted abilities are down; clear the wave with Naafiri P We Are More and Q Darkin Daggers. When you can push the lane, use the movement speed from Naafiri W The Call of the Pack to move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, Naafiri can clear and poke with her pack, but you need to watch Yasuo's approach paths and tornadoes as you fight. In late-game front-to-back teamfights, area damage can wipe out the pack and reduce your damage, so build on the lead you gained in the mid game.
Yasuo.teamfight: Don't engage from the front; use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit from the side or behind to target one enemy backliner. If Yasuo's area damage is coming, recall the pack with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or E Eviscerate, and restore thinned packmates with E Eviscerate. Engage when you can contribute to a takedown, then use the second cast of R Hounds' Pursuit on your next target or to escape.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so when he approaches, dodge to the side instead of only backing away. After he lands Q twice, his next Q sends a tornado that knocks you up, so watch for the sound and visual effect and be ready to dodge. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, change your angle for Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or save it until the wall disappears.

Yone.build: Yone Q Mortal Steel deals physical damage, while Yone P Way of the Hunter deals magic damage, so don’t build only one type of resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health, so prioritize movement speed to leave its telegraphed area instead of greatly increasing health alone. The available information isn’t enough to determine a specific item order.
Yone.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, then apply a bleed to Yone with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and send the pack to attack. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then land the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and basic attacks while the bleed lasts. If Yone’s area damage has hurt the pack, time Naafiri E Eviscerate to heal it.
Yone.escape: After Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is gone, check whether Yone has used E Soul Unbound and R Fate Sealed before engaging. If Yone has used only one mobility ability, he can escape with the other, so look especially for an opening before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up. At that point, close the distance with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate, but use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit only when you are certain you can contribute to a takedown.
Yone.fight: Don’t engage while Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is ready. Once the tornado is gone and Yone E Soul Unbound or Yone R Fate Sealed is down, check the pack’s numbers, then apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and land the second cast. If Yone’s area damage has worn down the pack, recall and heal it with Naafiri E Eviscerate before continuing your damage.
Yone.laning: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, keep your distance and watch for his tornado. Then push the lane and use the movement speed from Naafiri W The Call of the Pack to create a numbers advantage in a side lane or the enemy jungle.
Yone.phase: In late-game front-to-back teamfights, area damage can clear the pack, so build on your midgame lead.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield doesn’t grow, and don’t stand alone at the very back of the formation in the path of Yone R Fate Sealed. Instead of engaging head-on, check the pack’s numbers and whether area damage has been used from the flank, then pick off one backline champion with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit. Use the second cast of Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit, earned with a takedown, to close in on another target or escape.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to charge his tornado, stay out of range and wait for the stacks to expire. After Yone E Soul Unbound engages, he can deal extra damage when he returns, so if your health is low, use the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or Naafiri E Eviscerate, or create distance. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path and moves him behind the last champion, so before a teamfight, check that you aren’t alone at the very back of your formation.

Zed.build: Build armor early to withstand the physical damage from Zed Q Razor Shuriken, Zed E Shadow Slash, and Zed R Death Mark. Armor does not counter Zed P Contempt for the Weak, which deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Zed.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, then apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers. Close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, then land the second cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers on the bleeding Zed and finish with basic attacks. If Zed can retreat, don’t use Naafiri E Eviscerate too early and lose your way to pursue him.
Zed.escape: Don’t engage just because Zed W Living Shadow alone is down. After Zed has also used R Death Mark, look for an opening, especially before it comes back up, and close the distance with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, Naafiri E Eviscerate, and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit. Check the position of Zed W Living Shadow to avoid the slow area of Zed E Shadow Slash as well.
Zed.fight: Right after Zed uses W Living Shadow, look for an opening once the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already switched positions. Apply a bleed and send the pack to attack with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, then line up the second cast and land it while the bleed lasts. If Zed’s area damage has worn down the pack, restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate to maintain your damage.
Zed.laning: Clear minions with the pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers while keeping up in levels. Don’t force your way in before Zed’s abilities are down, and right before trading, target Zed with Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers so the pack isn’t attacking minions. After pushing the lane, use your movement speed to move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle and create a numbers advantage.
Zed.phase: Midgame is a strong period for Zed and for Naafiri’s roaming and flanks, so look for openings when his mobility is down without letting Zed gain an advantage first. Zed gets weaker late, but Naafiri’s pack can still be cleared by area damage in front-to-back teamfights, so fight from the flank.
Zed.teamfight: Check Zed’s position and use of mobility from the flank or behind instead of engaging head-on. Build up the pack, and if area damage has worn it down, restore it with Naafiri E Eviscerate before engaging with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit on a target you can pick off. If you get a takedown, use the available recast of Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit to close in on another target or escape.
Zed.watch: Zed Q Razor Shuriken can wear down the pack with area damage, so recall the pack with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or Naafiri E Eviscerate before it hits. Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move outside the slow area of Zed E Shadow Slash from the shadow. If you are marked by Zed R Death Mark, avoid Zed’s follow-up attacks until the mark detonates.

Zoe.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave the spot telegraphed by Zoe Q Paddle Star!, and build magic resistance rather than armor. Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble lowers magic resistance and also deals true damage, so consider health to withstand that damage. Before starting an objective, use a Control Ward to reveal paths where bubble traps may be placed.
Zoe.combo: Activate Naafiri W The Call of the Pack before engaging, then apply a bleed with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and send the pack to Zoe. Follow with Naafiri E Eviscerate to close in, then land the second Q cast and basic attacks while the bleed lasts. Use Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit to engage only when you can reliably pick off Zoe.
Zoe.escape: The best window to engage is right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. If Zoe uses R to move, target the spot where she will return.
Zoe.fight: Close the distance and fight right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. Apply a bleed and send the pack to attack with the first cast of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, then land the second cast while the bleed lasts. Build up the pack just before the fight, and if Zoe Q Paddle Star!’s area damage might clear it, recall the pack with Naafiri W The Call of the Pack or E Eviscerate.
Zoe.laning: Early on, don’t force your way toward ranged Zoe. Use the pack and Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers to secure the wave pushing into you and distant last hits. Only look to trade when Zoe’s skillshots are down. If you can push the lane, use the movement speed from Naafiri W The Call of the Pack to move to a side lane or into the enemy jungle.
Zoe.phase: Early laning is difficult because melee Naafiri has to farm against ranged Zoe, so focus on keeping up in levels. In late-game front-to-back teamfights, the pack is easy to clear with area damage, so avoid engaging head-on.
Zoe.teamfight: Confirm Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, then close in on Zoe from the flank or behind. When engaging with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit, make sure you can reliably pick off the first target so a takedown lets you use the second R to pursue another target or escape.
Zoe.watch: If you are hit by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, you’ll fall asleep after a short delay, so move behind a wall or an ally before then to leave the angle and range of Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Even a bubble that misses remains as a trap, so watch narrow paths without vision and brush entrances. Zoe R Portal Jump always returns her to her starting point, so look for her there.
